summary: The recorded base reproduces the CP exporter-cardinality defect: CP=8 creates eight default scheduler metrics exporters. The exact candidate requires both attention TP rank zero and attention CP rank zero, reducing the default to one exporter. The submitted regression, an independent topology matrix, and the full observability unit suite pass on the candidate.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through the actual SchedulerMetricsCollector.init_new: CP=8 selected 8 default exporters instead of 1; 3 assertions failed and 7 passed. See evidence/base_candidate_regression.log.
The candidate's issue-specific regression and boundary cases passed: 10 tests. See evidence/candidate_regression.log.

Independent matrix of CP sizes 1/2/3/8 and attention-TP sizes 1/2/4 selected exactly one default exporter in all 12 topologies; the explicit all-schedulers override enabled every scheduler while retaining one log leader. See evidence/candidate_adversarial.log.
The complete observability unit directory passed: 188 tests and 4 subtests. See evidence/candidate_observability.log.
Confirmed imports came from /job/repo/python and recorded Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, and one AMD Instinct MI350X GPU. See evidence/candidate_import_environment.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: The interpreter enumerated one AMD Instinct MI350X GPU, but the focused checks did not execute GPU kernels. The reported CP=8 topology requires eight participating devices and could not be reproduced end to end.

remaining_limitations: The original eight-H20 CP=8 HTTP/model-serving deployment and a real Prometheus scrape were not run because only one gfx950-family GPU was assigned and no H20 hardware or model weights were provided.
No full-model, semantic-accuracy, multi-node, transport, or performance claim is made.

The explicit enable_metrics_for_all_schedulers option intentionally exports from every scheduler and can therefore produce multiple series; this is preserved documented behavior, not a counterexample to the default-path fix.

The candidate report recorded an AMD Instinct MI355X whereas this review environment reported AMD Instinct MI350X; both are single-device gfx950-family environments and neither qualifies an eight-H20 reproduction.
